deep-forest.$description: Deep Forest — Primary brand color, nav logo, dark pill buttons, text accents, badge borders, link colors — the structural green that anchors the palette

lime-glow.$description: Lime Glow — Green action color for filled buttons, selected navigation states, and focused conversion moments.

sage-mist.$description: Sage Mist — Section backgrounds, card surfaces, content band alternation — soft botanical green that signals freshness without competing with the food photography

warm-sand.$description: Warm Sand — Accent surface for alternate section bands — warm beige that pairs with food photography and adds earthy variety to the green-dominant palette

cream-canvas.$description: Cream Canvas — Primary page background, the warm off-white that gives the entire system its organic, non-clinical feel

forest-shadow.$description: Forest Shadow — Primary text color, borders, input strokes — near-black with a barely-perceptible green undertone that harmonizes with the brand greens

pure-ink.$description: Pure Ink — Maximum-contrast text, hairlines, icon strokes — used where absolute sharpness is needed

warm-gray.$description: Warm Gray — Medium-contrast borders, control outlines, and structural separators. Do not promote it to the primary CTA color

slate-gray.$description: Slate Gray — Secondary text in disabled or low-emphasis button contexts

sweetsans.$description: Display headlines, hero text, large category labels — used at extreme sizes (70–80px) with tight leading (0.85) that lets letterforms nearly touch; weight 400 at this size is the signature choice, creating a calm authority that doesn't shout

grenette.$description: Secondary display accent — ultra-thin weight with extreme negative tracking creates a delicate, editorial counterpoint to the geometric SweetSans display

sweetsanstext.$description: Body text, navigation, button labels, card descriptions, footers — positive tracking (0.01–0.05em) improves readability at small sizes; weight 700 for labels and CTAs, 400 for body

sweetsanstext-regular.$description: Small UI text, micro-labels, fine print — the regular-weight variant for the smallest readable sizes
